name: Dr Christopher Fox
title: Sex Therapist
description: I am a European Certified Psycho-Sexologist and a trained Counsellor/Therapist with over 20 years experience, holding Clinical/Level 4 membership of the Australian Counselling Association, one of Australia’s leading counselling and psychotherapy regulating bodies. I work with individuals and couples of any sexual orientation on a short or long term basis. As a sex therapist or sex counsellor, I work in an integrative, structured framework using a solution-focused approach combined with evidence-based strategies such as cognitive-behavioural therapy and systemic theories in the main.
specialties: Men's and Women's sexual health and wellbeing.  I work with couples, men and women on issues relating to their sexuality.

name: July Lies
title: Psychologist
description: After graduating, she worked at the Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Department and served young people from diverse ethnicities, many of them diagnosed with behavioural and emotional patterns stemming from abuses and traumatising events in their childhood. Specifically, she provided specialised trauma-informed assessment and intervention to young people and families from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds. In private practice, she works with clients struggling with overcoming PTSD, mood and anxiety disorders, insomnia disorders, attachment and interpersonal difficulties, as well as life transition difficulties. July bore witness to recurring traumatic loops in the absence of rest, attunement, authenticity and self-compassion that plagues both minds and bodies.
specialties: Effects of trauma/PTSD; Stress and anxiety; Sleep disturbance; Life transition difficulties; LGBTQ

name: Dr Kayleigh Young
title: Clinical Psychologist, Psychologist
description: Kayleigh works with clients of all ages experiencing a range of concerns including depression, anxiety, stress, trauma, abuse, workplace issues, interpersonal difficulties, grief and loss, and substance use, among other mental health and wellbeing issues. These include Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), Mindfulness, Motivational Interviewing, Solution Focused Therapy, Strengths-Based approaches, Schema Therapy and Trauma Therapy.

name: Jayde Smith
title: Psychologist
description: I incorporate mindfulness, Dialectical Behavioural Therapy (DBT), and Schema Therapy into client sessions.

name: Nadine Galloway
title: Psychologist
description: My professional interests include women's health, trauma-informed practices and psychedelic integration. Using a client-centered approach means that therapy will be tailored to the person in front of me, however, I have training in and use the following modalities in my practice: Cognitive Behaviour Therapy (CBT), Schema Therapy, Motivational Interviewing, Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT), Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR) and Psychedelic Integration.
specialties: Depression, anxiety, post-traumatic stress disorder and substance use disorders, professional interests include women’s mental health, trauma-informed therapy and psychedelic integration.

name: Prue Chambers
title: Psychotherapist
description: I provide counselling and therapy to children, young people and adults in the areas of mental health, trauma, adapting to change, emotional support for gifted and talented children, grief and loss, relationship issues including sexual issues. I have a unique speciality of supporting clients in all age ranges with sexual identity, sexual difficulties such as low libido or desire, pain and relationship issues. I have specialised training in the area neurobiology of childhood trauma including abuse. I am qualified to support children and their families including adult survivors of abuse with immediate and long term effects of trauma.
specialties: Relationship Issues, Sex Therapy, Trauma and PTSD.

name: Shey Cooper
title: Psychologist
description: I integrate a range of psychological approaches and evidence-based treatments, including CBT, ACT, EMDR, Trauma, and mindfulness-based therapies, tailored to the individual's needs.
specialties: ADHD, Anxiety, Depression, Autism, Life Transitions, Compulsive (OCD).

name: Cindy Wang
title: Psychologist
description: The people I serve I have experience working with Post Traumatic Stress Disorder, Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder, Autism Spectrum Disorder, Schizophrenia, Bipolar Disorder, Borderline Personality Disorder, Adjustment Disorder, anxiety, and depression. Therapy Types Eye Movement Desensitisation Reprocessing (EMDR): a psychotherapy treatment designed to alleviate distress associated with traumatic memories through guided eye movements and other sensory inputs.
specialties: Trauma, post-traumatic growth, resilience, and mindfulness. I am fascinated by depth psychology (psychology of the soul) and cross-cultural psychology.
